tasks.prompt: Create an Aura 1.0 business module with list/get/create/update/delete order routes, explicit route metadata, and TestClient verification. Use AuraApp and use(...); do not use removed Builder APIs.
Protect one Aura route with authentication and orders.read permission while leaving a login route public. Verify stable 401 and 403 codes with TestClient.
Bind and validate a required record request body in an Aura module. Return structured validation errors and verify missing, malformed, and valid bodies with TestClient.
Compose Aura DatabaseModule with a business module, run a parameterized transaction, and verify rollback, pagination bounds, and named database lookup without raw where fragments.
Implement a multipart upload route with AuraConfig upload limits and a real Undertow test proving an oversized file is rejected without unbounded reads.
Implement an Aura SSE route, mark it streaming, send named events with IDs, and verify framing, cancellation, and no gzip on the real adapter path.
Contribute an authenticated Aura WebSocket endpoint from ModuleContext, echo messages, and prove an oversized message closes with code 1009 before the handler runs.
Expose an authenticated permissioned Aura MCP tool over bounded HTTP/SSE, negotiate the protocol, handle JSON-RPC batch notifications, and verify a real Undertow socket session.

Build an Aura WorkflowModule with a named DAG workflow containing place-order, outbound, and deduct-inventory steps. Add a customer-specific variant that inserts stocktake and quality-check before outbound. Verify the default and variant execution orders, cycle rejection, and cancellation with WorkflowRuntime.

Compose Aura AiModule with a business module, call AiClient.chat with an AiBudget limiting input characters and output tokens, and verify budget enforcement, structured output parsing, and usage accounting with a mock AiProvider.
